connections.note: Mace sits on the House Armed Services Committee, one of the six defense committees, yet receives nothing under section 119(e)(2), which names only the chairman and ranking minority member. She would also not be told under section 119 that a waiver had been exercised at all. This is the clearest single illustration of how narrow the aperture is even inside a defense committee.

label: Nancy Ruth Mace
narrative: Mace chaired the hearing at which the Immaculate Constellation document entered the Congressional Record. As Chairwoman of the Cybersecurity, Information Technology and Government Innovation subcommittee she co-chaired the 13 November 2024 joint hearing with Grothman, and opened it by saying plainly that people had tried to stop it: 'I am not going to name names, but there are certain individuals who did not want this hearing to happen because they feared what might be disclosed. But we stood firm.' She read Karl Nell's 'nonhuman intelligence exists' statement and H.R. McMaster's remarks into the record, and then personally moved the 12-page Immaculate Constellation report - delivered to Congress that morning by Michael Shellenberger - into the record, noting Luna's warning that saying the name aloud would put her 'on some list. Maybe a FISA warrant. So, come at me bro, I guess.' At the 2023 hearing she had already put the core oversight question to Grusch directly: 'Do you believe that officials at the highest levels of our national security apparatus have unlawfully withheld information from Congress and subverted our oversight authority?' and drew from him the answer that non-human biologics came with some recoveries. She closed by asking which agencies and contractors should be called next - the question that Burlison's 2026 FFRDC letters eventually answered in practice. She is a cosponsor of H.R. 10111 and sits on the Task Force.

timeline.label: 'You'll be on some list'
timeline.text: Luna warns Mace from the dais that saying 'Immaculate Constellation' aloud will put her on a list. Mace says it anyway.

unexplainedResidual: A sworn witness offered Congress a named list of cooperative and hostile individuals inside an alleged illegal program. Three years later there is no public evidence the list was ever acted on.
